historical_exposure: Fish adjacency, numeral fixity, site, carrier, size and motif were examined in prior packages. All real-data results are frozen evaluations on previously examined material.
joint_credence_rule: Functional compound labels start at 0.35; A+B pass gives 0.55, one pass gives 0.45, neither gives 0.20. Carrier C adds at most 0.05 and changes carrier scope only. Narrow astronomical model starts at 0.15, rises to 0.30 only on its full pass rule and falls to 0.05 on failure. No sound-value update from structure alone.

predictions.statistic: Component sign test of adjacent unequal fish codes against a discovery-learned total order
predictions.null: Each dependency component's direction is equiprobable
predictions.pass_rule: At least 15 untied components, >=75% positive and one-sided exact p <= 0.05/3

predictions.statistic: Component mean log2 predictive advantage of fish-specific values L over a nonfish variable-count reference Q
predictions.null: Component score differences have equiprobable signs
predictions.pass_rule: At least 15 untied components, positive mean and all deletion means, one-sided exact p <= 0.05/3

predictions.statistic: Fish versus other frequency/position-matched signs in seal share, residualized by site and length bin
predictions.null: Within-discovery-band rearrangements of graphic class labels
predictions.pass_rule: Bench meaning-map, 9999 draws, p <= 0.05/3, all leave-one-component-out contrasts positive, at least eight components per sign

predictions.statistic: Canonical values 3,6,7 in B001 short-stroke groups before plain fish on seals and predictive log scores; B031 long-stroke compounds excluded
predictions.null: Q variable counts and L fish-specific fixed expressions
predictions.pass_rule: At least 20 components, canonical-share Wilson95 lower bound >=0.8, positive component-mean gain over Q and L, and strict-stroke pass
